name: F10 rules, inspector reasons and small PCB fixes
description: Definition-of-done slice F10 (audit S16, S17 PCB part, S19) on an isolated fixture with one resistor synced to the PCB and a 3D model reference on its library part. S19 (ADR-0050): Design rules sets a max component height, then emptying the field and applying is accepted as an explicit clear (before, an empty field meant 'unchanged', so that Apply changed nothing), and a further Apply with the field still empty is refused as no change, so the limit is gone. S16: the footprint's 3D model row in the inspector shows the library part's model path and quality instead of 'the EAK-IR has no field'; the Route tool's arc-corners row no longer says the EAK-IR has no arc tracks. S17: with the Route tool and no route started, Finish route and Rip up & re-route are disabled and say why. The click-then-click Move grid delta (DoD audit defect 6) is covered by vitest (editors.test.tsx F10 regressions): this harness cannot place the two clicks on known board coordinates under the Canvas2D renderer.
